question: 'The Flying Apsara' painting is a masterpiece in which of the following caves?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajanta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **'The Flying Apsara'** is a famous painting located in the **Ajanta Caves**, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Maharashtra, India.
 
• Ajanta Caves are renowned for their exquisite **Buddhist rock-cut architecture** and paintings depicting Jataka tales and the life of Buddha.
 
• 'The Flying Apsara' painting showcases the **elegance and intricate artistry** of ancient Indian painters, emphasizing movement and grace.
 
• The Ajanta frescoes are painted using the **tempera technique**, combining natural pigments and plant-based adhesives to create enduring artworks.
 
• The caves date back to **2nd century BCE to 6th century CE**, representing one of the finest examples of Indian classical art traditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ajanta Caves:**

 
 
• The Ajanta Caves consist of 30 caves, including monasteries and prayer halls, carved into the rock face of a horseshoe-shaped cliff.
 
• The caves are primarily dedicated to **Buddhism** and were used by monks for meditation and teaching.
 
• They are an important cultural and historical site, preserving ancient Indian art, architecture, and religious practices.
 
 
 
• **Artistic Techniques:**
 
 
• The tempera technique used in Ajanta paintings involves mixing pigments with a binding agent such as gum or egg yolk.
 
• The artists employed natural light in the caves, which filtered through openings, to work on the intricate details.
 
• The paintings depict themes like **Buddhist myths, deities, and daily life activities**, showcasing the harmony between religion and art.
 
 
 
• **Apsaras in Indian Art:**
 
 
• Apsaras are celestial maidens or dancers in Indian mythology, often associated with grace, beauty, and divine energy.
 
• 'The Flying Apsara' painting symbolizes the **dynamic movement and ethereal presence** of these celestial beings.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Status:**
 
 
• The Ajanta Caves were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in **1983**.
 
• They are recognized for their historical importance and artistic achievement, drawing visitors and scholars from around the world.
